mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the membrane fats with water was most worthwhile: the cutaway helped me picture how a boundary separates inside from outside.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the nucleus in the bag was the least interesting decision because the new goal made the pairing obvious, though it completed the model.

surprise.text: The nucleus picture showed a small RNA strand leaving through a pore as a copy of one DNA instruction. I hadn't expected that detail from enclosing the DNA.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each pairing a clear purpose.

continue.text: I might continue to see what else a cell needs beyond a membrane bag and nucleus. The pictures made these first connections understandable, although the choices so far were fairly obvious.
